backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor that includes blob storage mixin and defines types for RenderOrderRule and GenesisCraftPreview (kept for frontend compatibility).
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting a Vault Publishing Controls download button feature for retrieving IPFS-uploaded files from Pinata.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Comprehensive summaries of all frontend source files including components, pages, hooks, utilities, and configuration files.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with design tokens for light and dark themes, defining color variables for UI components using oklch color space.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point that loads the React application from /src/main.tsx with viewport and charset meta tags.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main application component managing project state, multi-blockchain support (ICP, ETH, SOL, POLYGON, BNB, BASE), lazy-loaded views, persistence with atomic saves, and comprehensive TypeScript interfaces for layers, traits, rules, NFTs, and IPFS publishing.
frontend/src/components/ConfirmDestructi: Reusable confirmation dialog component using Zustand store for destructive actions with customizable title, description, and callbacks.
frontend/src/components/dashboard/Create: A dialog form for creating new NFT projects with fields for name, symbol, collection size, and pixel art mode toggle.
frontend/src/components/dashboard/NewPro: A clickable tile with a plus icon that triggers the creation of a new project, styled with dashed borders and hover effects.
frontend/src/components/dashboard/Projec: A dialog form for editing existing project settings including name, symbol, collection size, and pixel art mode with validation.
A card component displaying project information (name, blockchain, collection size, creation date) with hover actions for settings and deletion.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Minimalist footer displaying copyright and caffeine.ai attribution with heart icon.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Navigation header with responsive mobile menu, project info display, save status indicator, and navigation buttons for all app views (Workshop, Rarity, Rules, Preview, Forge, Vault, Settings).
frontend/src/components/HoverTooltip.tsx: Tooltip component that displays content on hover/focus with fade-in animation and arrow pointer.
frontend/src/components/icons/index.tsx: Exports lightweight inline SVG icon components (Menu, X, Heart, Download, RefreshCw, Search, Filter, Copy, CheckCircle2, XCircle, Loader2) to replace heavy lucide-react imports.
frontend/src/components/MotionIconButton: Reusable icon button component with Apple HIG motion system animations (scale on hover/active) and focus ring styling.
frontend/src/components/PinataKeyGuideDi: A dialog component that provides step-by-step instructions for obtaining a Pinata JWT token, including warnings about using the correct credential field and links to Pinata's website.
frontend/src/components/SaveStatusIndica: A fixed-width status indicator component that displays save states (idle, saving, saved, failed) with appropriate styling and transitions to prevent layout shift.
frontend/src/components/VaultPublishingC: Controls for locking/unlocking collections and uploading NFT data to IPFS via Pinata, with progress tracking, error handling, and download functionality for published collections.
frontend/src/components/VaultViewModeTog: A toggle button component that switches between 'compact' and 'grid' view modes for displaying vault contents.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: React hook that creates and manages an ICP backend actor with authentication, automatically recreating the actor when identity changes and invalidating dependent queries.
frontend/src/hooks/useConfirmDestructive: Zustand-based hook providing a promise-based confirmation dialog for destructive actions with configurable title, description, and callbacks.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: React context and hook for Internet Identity authentication, managing login state, identity persistence, and AuthClient lifecycle with configurable options.
frontend/src/hooks/usePinataKeyValidatio: React hook that debounces and validates Pinata JWT tokens, returning validation status (idle, checking, valid, invalid) and messages.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with dark theme design tokens, custom motion/easing variables, accessibility features, and utility classes for shadows, transitions, and component styling.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React root with QueryClient and InternetIdentityProvider wrappers around the main App component.
frontend/src/pages/Builder.tsx: NFT builder component with genesis (trait-based) and direct upload modes, featuring canvas preview rendering, file upload queue management, and token deletion with confirmation dialogs.
frontend/src/pages/Dashboard.tsx: Dashboard page component that displays a grid of project tiles with create, open, edit settings, and delete functionality. Includes hero section with branding and uses confirmation dialogs for destructive actions.
frontend/src/pages/Preview.tsx: Preview page that renders NFT combinations on a canvas by merging layer images based on selected traits. Supports random shuffling with rule validation, pixel art mode, and weighted trait selection.
frontend/src/pages/RarityWorkshop.tsx: Rarity management interface for adjusting trait weights within layers using sliders. Features weight normalization to 100%, locking/unlocking traits, randomization, and proportional redistribution of weights.
frontend/src/pages/Rules.tsx: Rules editor for defining trait compatibility constraints (exclude/force rules). Allows creating, editing, duplicating, and deleting rules that control which trait combinations are valid.
frontend/src/pages/Settings.tsx: Project settings page for configuring metadata format, blockchain selection, output size, Pinata API keys, and Solana creator shares. Includes validation for API keys and creator share totals.
frontend/src/pages/Vault.tsx: Main Vault page component that manages NFT generation using a Web Worker, displays generated NFTs with filtering/sorting/search, calculates rarity scores, and provides export functionality (ZIP download with images and metadata). Includes a SimpleZipCreator class for client-side ZIP file generation.
frontend/src/pages/Workshop.tsx: Workshop page component for managing project layers and traits, including adding/deleting/reordering layers, editing layer properties (opacity, blend mode), managing traits with inline editing, and handling drag-and-drop reordering.
Utility for processing uploaded images for Forge Direct Injection by converting any image to a square PNG at configured output size using cover strategy (scale and crop), with optional pixel-art mode that disables image smoothing.
frontend/src/utils/ipfsPublishing.ts: Handles uploading NFT collections to IPFS via Pinata in two stages: first uploads images as a directory to get a CID, then generates and uploads metadata JSON files with ipfs:// URIs pointing to the images directory.
frontend/src/utils/metadataPresets.ts: Builds NFT metadata objects for different blockchain formats (Ethereum/ERC-721, Solana, ICP, Polygon, Base, BNB) with template resolution for token names, handling format-specific fields like Solana creators and royalties, and supporting both local and IPFS image URIs.
frontend/src/utils/persistence.ts: Centralized localStorage persistence utility implementing last-write-wins strategy with single canonical snapshot key, including legacy cleanup for old temp/backup keys and storage quota checking (4.5MB threshold).
frontend/src/utils/pinata.ts: Provides functions to validate Pinata JWT tokens, upload files and JSON to IPFS via Pinata API, and upload multiple files as a directory with filename sanitization.
frontend/src/utils/vaultGeneratorProtoco: Defines TypeScript interfaces and type guards for message protocol communication between the Vault UI and the NFT generator web worker, including layer/trait data, generation messages, and progress updates.
frontend/src/utils/yieldToUI.ts: Exports a utility function that yields execution back to the browser event loop using requestAnimationFrame and setTimeout to keep the UI responsive during long operations.
frontend/src/workers/vaultGenerator.work: Web Worker that generates NFT collections off the main thread by performing trait selection, rule validation, DNA uniqueness checks, and optional image compositing using OffscreenCanvas when supported.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration extending the default theme with custom colors using CSS variables, border radii, spacing, typography, animations, and keyframes for the Layer Studio UI.
project_state.json: Project metadata tracking the Layer Studio NFT generator's architecture, features, and pending feature request to add a download button for retrieving uploaded files from Pinata after successful IPFS upload.
